text:
Priya Nair: Hey team — need to lock a design review for SDK auth v2 + Console token UX. Pre-read: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdkauth/pre-read (working). Suggested windows next week: Tue 10:00-10:45, Wed 11:00-11:45, Thu 14:00-14:45. Meeting length 45m. Can you call out conflicts? Also please review pre-read checklist:

```
- API changes summary (2 slides)
- SDK migration guide draft
- Console mockups + state flows
- Security KMs: KMS/HSM impact note
- Rollout plan + feature flag strategy
- Test plan: e2e + contract tests
```

Alex Chen: Wed 11 works for me. 45m is fine. Can we add a short 'rollback/fallback' section in the pre-read?

Evelyn Park: I can update mockups today and add the state table. Will push mocks to the doc and ping when ready.

Samir Gupta: Can't on Tue morning. Wed 11 or Thu 14 both ok for me. Prefer Wed if that works for Alex.

Marta Lopez: Adding a quick checklist for CI/QA owners — I can draft e2e gates. Also who's owning the console rollout notes?

calendar-bot: Tentative poll created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/poll/abc123 — please vote by EOD tomorrow :calendar:

Priya Nair: OK locking Wed 11-11:45 unless veto by EOD. Evelyn — thanks, please include annotated mock click-through. Marta — can you take rollout notes? Alex — I'll add rollback section to pre-read.

Alex Chen: Yep I'll draft rollback + fallback heuristics. Also propose a 10m breakout for SDK maintainers at end.

Evelyn Park: :thumbsup: I'll upload mocks in ~2hrs and tag @Priya and @Alex.

Samir Gupta: Ack. See you Wed.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — final agenda will be in the doc. If you have quick comments, drop them inline in the pre-read so we can keep the session focused.
